# `org.delete`

Delete an organization

Session-only, organization owners. Refuses while the organization still holds repositories.

- Method and path: `POST /{org}/-/settings/delete`
- Scope: `repo:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie org delete`
- MCP: `org_delete`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely
